_comment: Minimal bundle — for Raspberry Pi and low-disk installs. Keeps ZIM total under 5 GB. Final ZIM selection is an [E] task in Milestone 3; this is a draft.
name: minimal
description: WikiMed medical reference and iFixit repair guides. Sized for Raspberry Pi with a USB SSD and limited free space.

hardware.notes: Disk estimate covers ZIM files only; add ~2-4 GB for a small AI model (e.g. qwen2.5:3b). Pi 4 with 4 GB RAM can run qwen2.5:3b; 8 GB RAM is recommended for the 7B model.

model.name: qwen2.5:3b
model.notes: Smaller model for Pi. Slower and less capable than 7B but fits in 4 GB RAM.
